page.overview:
Who is Leesa Chaffni?

Leesa Chaffni was a Kessurian female who resided in Cratertown on the planet Jakku alongside her father Lubos during the New Republic Era and the following First Order-Resistance War. She also owned a skittermouse she had nicknamed Tails, which accompanied her everywhere in her pocket after she had rescued him from a predator during her childhood. After her father hurt his leg in an accident at work in the local kesium mines, Leesa began working as a help at Dai's Cafe.

Between 34 ABY and 35 ABY, when she was twelve years old, Chaffni overheard the Jakkuvian scavenger Velorie Sarcon bragging at the Cafe about a contract she had gotten to retrieve the contents of a vault on the crashed Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser Explorator of Imperial Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III in the desert sands north of the Kelvin Ravine on Jakku. When Sarcon realized that Chafni had listened, she confronted and bullied her, but was stopped by the patrons and Resistance members Rey, Finn and BB-8, and left. Sarcon and her droid RJ-21, as well as Chaffni, who hoped to find medical supplies for her father, and the Resistance members, then each made their way to the Dreadnought. On her way to the ship through the tunnels of an abandoned kesium mine, Cafni was almost killed by a swarm of gnaw-jaws and was only saved by stumbling into the wreck were she was found by Rey and Finn and BB-8. On the Explorator, the four ultimately joined forces with Sarcon and found the vault, but came to a standoff with Sarcon's client, the First Order officer Dihun, and her stormtroopers in the hangar. During the confrontation, RJ-21 then betrayed his companions and and opened the vault door unleashing Korda's prototype nightwatcher droid from the vault, which attacked everyone in the hangar. However, Rey managed to briefly control the droid with Korda's control circlet so that they could overwrite Korda's corrupting code and calm the droid, which then rescued Rey, Finn, BB-8, Chaffni, Sarcon and Sarcon's former associate Ivrax from the ship while it sank beneath the sand dunes. Back at home Sarcon fixed the magna-cast they had found in the Explorator medical bay to Lubos's leg and Lubos and Leesa invited Sarcon to live with them in their home. Chaffni later relayed the story of her recent adventure to Dai's Cafe patron Naldri Zuvio.

Leesa Chaffni first appeared in The Jaws of Jakku, an Audible-exclusive audiobook written by Cavan Scott and narrated by Helen Sadler, In the book, the story is presented as being told in-universe by Leesa Chaffni to Naldri Zuvio who stands in for the actual real-world listener. The spelling of Leesa Chaffni's first name was confirmed by a chapter title, but due to being an audio exclusive, the spelling her last name has not yet been confirmed.
